atoms.sound: Hello everyone! My name is Noor, and this is my presentation about the human body. Our bodies are made up of many different parts like the head, arms, legs and chest. Each body part has a job. For example, with our eyes we can see, we use our legs to walk or run and we hold things with our hands. Each body part is important and allows us to function in our every day life. We need to remember to take care of our bodies by eating healthy foods, exercising regularly and being kind to ourselves. Our bodies do so many different things. They are so cool!

atoms.sound: Hi everyone. My name is Reece and this is my presentation on bodily expressions. We can also use our body to express ourselves in different ways. For example, I wave my hand to my friend when I see her on the street or I shrug my shoulders when I’m unsure about something. We can use our face to show emotions too. I raise my eyebrows when I’m surprised or I smile with my mouth when I’m happy. Our body can help us to express what we feel inside!
